# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/rundir.sh. test-rundir.sh runs each one in a working directory that
# holds the run directory audit_1 (made by rundir.sh new audit), a.rs and src/.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each
# case prints nothing on stdout and changes nothing in the working directory.
64	rundir: refused: usage: rundir.sh new audit|incident, check <R>, sub <R> <rel>, or store	nope
64	rundir: refused: usage: rundir.sh new audit|incident, check <R>, sub <R> <rel>, or store	--help
64	rundir: refused: usage: rundir.sh new audit|incident, check <R>, sub <R> <rel>, or store	-x
64	rundir: refused: usage: rundir.sh new audit|incident, check <R>, sub <R> <rel>, or store	NEW
64	rundir: refused: usage: rundir.sh new audit|incident, check <R>, sub <R> <rel>, or store	create
64	rundir: refused: new takes one word: audit or incident	new
64	rundir: refused: new takes one word: audit or incident	new	audit	x
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not project	new	project
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not Audit	new	Audit
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not AUDIT	new	AUDIT
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not ../audit	new	../audit
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not audit_1	new	audit_1
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not incidents	new	incidents
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not *	new	*
64	rundir: refused: new takes audit or incident, not -x	new	-x
64	rundir: refused: check takes one run directory	check
64	rundir: refused: check takes one run directory	check	audit_1	audit_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_	check	audit_
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_1234567	check	audit_1234567
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: Audit_1	check	Audit_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: AUDIT_1	check	AUDIT_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_1a	check	audit_1a
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_-1	check	audit_-1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_+1	check	audit_+1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_1/	check	audit_1/
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_1/poc	check	audit_1/poc
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: /tmp/audit_1	check	/tmp/audit_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: ../audit_1	check	../audit_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: report_1	check	report_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: incident_	check	incident_
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: incident_x	check	incident_x
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: audit_1.bak	check	audit_1.bak
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: src	check	src
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: .git	check	.git
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: .	check	.
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: ./	check	./
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: ~/audit_1	check	~/audit_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory must be a run directory named audit_<n> or incident_<n> in the working directory: -audit_1	check	-audit_1
64	rundir: refused: the run directory is not an existing directory: audit_99	check	audit_99
64	rundir: refused: the run directory is not an existing directory: incident_1	check	incident_1
64	rundir: refused: sub takes a run directory and one subdirectory	sub
64	rundir: refused: sub takes a run directory and one subdirectory	sub	audit_1
